    • finiteDiffRelStep

      public ScalarFunction.ScalarFunctionFactory finiteDiffRelStep(Matrix finiteDiffRelStep)
      Per-component relative step size for the FD gradient/Hessian. The absolute step is h = relStep * sign(x0) * max(1, |x0|), clamped to finiteDiffBounds(FiniteDifferenceBounds). May be null to derive a default from machine epsilon.
      Parameters:
      finiteDiffRelStep - relative step size (n x 1); may be null
      Returns:
      this factory, for chaining

    • finiteDiffBounds

      public ScalarFunction.ScalarFunctionFactory finiteDiffBounds(FiniteDifferenceBounds finiteDiffBounds)
      Bounds within which FD perturbations must stay. Defaults to unbounded.
      Parameters:
      finiteDiffBounds - box bounds for FD perturbations
      Returns:
      this factory, for chaining

      this factory, for chaining
